7.15.29, missed second class standard by 29 seconds
dropped out, ran out of water; printed 'Johh Morris' (misprint) in the dropout sentence

mentions.h: SEPTEMBER 3rd 1977 - LONDON TO BRIGHTON. LEICESTER'S TURN!

mentions.note: walked with son Peter; 50th Senior Mens 20km, 132:39

mentions.h: MORRIS DANCES TO FIFTH COLNBROOK TITLE.
mentions.note: won Colnbrook long distance walk championship, 2:21:34, his fifth win
completed the 100 miles at Ewhurst in his fastest time to date
16th in 20:23.30, a personal best; veteran, third 100

mentions.h: SEPTEMBER 29th 1979 - SUTTON COLDFIELD - FIRST NATIONAL 100KMS CHAMPIONSHIP
mentions.note: retired; had walked the Surrey 100 miles earlier
also a Field Events Judge and committee member
team award with George Beecham in the Endeavour 24 hours at Brighton; 100 miles in 22.27.50 in the Brighton 24 hours track walk, May 1981
149th National 10 miles; 45th Southern Area 20 miles; 61st National 35 km; 40th Surrey WC 100 miles
17th Colchester 100km; lifetime best 109¾ miles in 24 hours 1986
